LanguageData.DMS_OccultTechFont.label: Stele
LanguageData.DMS_OccultTechFont.description: A databank holding technical data and backups of colonial records, along with case analyses and post-incident reviews of every accident that has occurred across all colonization programs to date. A stele serves both as the medium through which the colonial fleets share experience and knowledge with their kin across star systems, and as a backup database buried deep beneath every colonized world. Complex encryption and verification algorithms keep its records from being lost over long voyages through space or ages sealed underground, while also preventing anyone outside the colonial fleets from obtaining the dangerous technology within.\n\nRumor has it that decoding techniques leaked by fleet deviants can perform a destructive scan to extract the data inside, but using such techniques may draw the hostility of the colonial fleets.
LanguageData.DMS_OccultechExtractor.label: Decoder
LanguageData.DMS_OccultechExtractor.description: A destructive decoding rig. It fires a high-energy laser through the holographic storage plates inside a stele and analyzes the scattered spectrum to read the data within: the only way for factions outside the colonial fleets to access a stele's contents. Set it flush against a stele and supply power, and it will continuously extract the knowledge and file it into your expeditional research, no researcher required. Extraction stops if the stele runs dry, power is lost, or no stele is in front of it. It can be uninstalled and reinstalled elsewhere.
